en.instruksi: Read the title, then put the organs the food passes through in order.
en.s-cerna: The journey of a plate of rice
en.cerna-mulut: mouth: chewed and wetted with saliva
en.cerna-usushalus: small intestine: nutrients absorbed into the blood
en.s-roti: The journey of a slice of bread
en.roti-kerongkongan: oesophagus: the mashed bread is pushed down
en.roti-lambung: stomach: the bread is churned with acid
en.roti-usushalus: small intestine: nutrients from the bread pass into the blood
en.roti-ususbesar: large intestine: water is taken back from what is left
en.roti-rektum: rectum: the waste is stored for a while
en.roti-anus: anus: the waste leaves the body
